def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    border = g[0][0]
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == border for v in g[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == border for r in range(h))]
    for ri in range(len(rs) - 1):
        r0, r1 = rs[ri], rs[ri + 1]
        if r1 - r0 < 3:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(cs) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cs[ci], cs[ci + 1]
            if c1 - c0 < 3:
                continue
            block = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in g[r0:r1 + 1]]
            bh, bw = len(block), len(block[0])
            top = 2 if bh > 3 and len(set(block[1])) == 1 else 1
            bottom = bh - (2 if bh > 3 and len(set(block[-2])) == 1 else 1)
            left = 2 if bw > 3 and len(set(row[1] for row in block)) == 1 else 1
            right = bw - (2 if bw > 3 and len(set(row[-2] for row in block)) == 1 else 1)
            a = [row[left:right] for row in block[top:bottom]]
            ah, aw = len(a), len(a[0])
            best = None
            rebuilt_best = None
            for p in range(1, ah // 2 + 2):
                for q in range(1, aw // 2 + 2):
                    rebuilt = [[0] * aw for _ in range(ah)]
                    errors = 0
                    for y in range(p):
                        for x in range(q):
                            cells = [(yy, xx) for yy in range(y, ah, p)
                                     for xx in range(x, aw, q)]
                            vals = [a[yy][xx] for yy, xx in cells]
                            value = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
                            for yy, xx in cells:
                                rebuilt[yy][xx] = value
                                errors += a[yy][xx] != value
                    key = (errors, p + q, p * q)
                    if best is None or key < best:
                        best = key
                        rebuilt_best = rebuilt
            for y in range(ah):
                for x in range(aw):
                    g[r0 + top + y][c0 + left + x] = rebuilt_best[y][x]
    return g

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    bg = out[0][0]
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == bg for x in out[r])]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(out[r][c] == bg for r in range(h))]

    for ra, rb in zip(horizontal, horizontal[1:]):
        for ca, cb in zip(vertical, vertical[1:]):
            if rb - ra < 4 or cb - ca < 4:
                continue
            # Exclude the two-cell-wide frame around the repeating pattern.
            pattern = [row[ca + 2:cb - 1] for row in out[ra + 2:rb - 1]]
            ph, pw = len(pattern), len(pattern[0])
            best_errors = ph * pw + 1
            best_period = None
            best_values = None
            for dy in range(1, ph + 1):
                for dx in range(1, pw + 1):
                    values = {}
                    errors = 0
                    for y in range(dy):
                        for x in range(dx):
                            cells = [pattern[yy][xx]
                                     for yy in range(y, ph, dy)
                                     for xx in range(x, pw, dx)]
                            counts = Counter(cells)
                            value, count = counts.most_common(1)[0]
                            values[y, x] = value
                            errors += len(cells) - count
                    if (errors < best_errors or
                            (errors == best_errors and best_period is not None
                             and dy * dx > best_period[0] * best_period[1])):
                        best_errors = errors
                        best_period = (dy, dx)
                        best_values = values
            dy, dx = best_period
            for y in range(ph):
                for x in range(pw):
                    out[ra + 2 + y][ca + 2 + x] = best_values[y % dy, x % dx]
    return out
